verses.text: Ix yalan winhaj Balaam t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Chek b'ochajk'e uke'ok altar t'a tik, tza chekan ik'chajkot ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, xchi winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Balac tas ix yal winh chi', ix smol ak'an juntzanh silab' chi' heb' winh schawanhil, jun nok' kelem wakax yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel t'a junjun altar.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Balaam chi' t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a stz'ey juntzanh silab' tik, ol b'at wila' tato sjawi Jehová yik slolon wet'ok, ol lajwok chi' ol walan t'ayach tas wal ol aj yalan t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh t'a jun niwan witz malaj ste'al.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ix hin b'ok'e uke' altar, ix wak'ankank'e junjun nok' wakax yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel t'a yib'anh junjun, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' tas ol aj slolon winh. Ix yalan icha tik: --Meltzajanh b'aj ayek' winhaj Balac chi', tzalan tas ix wal tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix meltzaj winh, ix k'ochxi winh b'aj aykan linhan winhaj Balac yet' heb' yichamtak winakil Moab t'a stz'ey silab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Ayinek' t'a jun witz t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yol yik Aram, ayik ix hin yawtankot winhaj Balac sreyal Moab. Kotanh, tza katab'an heb' israel. Alkan chukal lolonel t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi', xchib'at winh.
Palta, ¿tas wal tz'aj hin katab'an anima to manhok Dios skatab'ani? ¿Tas wal tz'aj wak'an chukal tato manhok Jehová tz'ak'an chukal t'ay?

Te wach' wilanb'at jun chonhab' chi' ayik ayink'e t'a schon jun k'e'en k'e'en tik. Te wach' wilanb'at t'a jolom witz b'aj ayinek' tik. Ha jun chonhab' chi' ch'ok yajeli, max somb'atlaj sb'a t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Lajanxo sb'isul jun chonhab' chi' icha spokokal lum lum, ¿tokwal ay mach stzak'wan sb'isan nanhalok heb'? Komonok wal ha hin tzin cham t'a junk'olal icha juntzanh anima to wach' spensar chi', xchi winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Balac chi', ix och ijan winh yalanoch t'a sat winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --¿Tas aji? Ha yuj ha katab'an heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin, yuj chi' hach wik'koti, palta haxo wach' lolonel tzalkan t'a yib'anh heb', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Yowalil ha tas schek Jehová wala', ha swala', xchi winh.
Palta ix ochnhej ijan winhaj Balac chi' yalan icha tik: --Konh wet' t'a junokxo lugar, b'aj janik'nhej syal kilan t'a stitak scampamento heb', ha wal ta' ol ha katab'ej heb' hin k'ana', xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at winhaj Balaam yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jun jakan t'a sjolom lum witz Pisga. Hata' ix schek winh b'ochajxik'e uke' altar, ix yak'anxi nok' wakax yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' winh silab'il, junjun nok' t'a junjun altar.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Balaam chi' t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a stz'ey altar tik, yakb'an b'at hin lolon yet' Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh, ix yalani tas ol yutok winh yalani. --Meltzajanh b'aj ayek' winhaj Balac chi', tzalan icha tz'aj walan tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix meltzaj winh b'aj aykan winhaj Balac yet' heb' ay yopisio aj Moab t'a stz'ey silab' chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Balac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik:

Ach Balac yuninal winhaj Zipor, scham wal ab'an tas ol wala': Ha Dios manh lajanok icha anima. Max yesejlaj, max ek'b'atlaj tas syala'. Tato ay junok tas syala', tz'elnhejk'ochi. Tato ay junok tas syaltej, syak'nhej.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin to swal wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalani, max yal-laj hin k'exani.
Malaj junok yahelal syil Jehová to ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' yik heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob. Ha Jehová sDiosal heb', ha ayoch sreyalok heb', aynhejpaxek' t'a skal heb'.
Ha Jehová ix ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha Jehová ayoch yipok sk'o'ol heb', icha nok' owal wakax ha sch'a'ak ayoch yipok sk'o'ol.

Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob malaj yelk'och heb' na'umel lolonel, malaj pax yelk'och heb' ajb'a'al. Ha tikne'ik yowalil tz'alchaj t'a chonhab' Israel icha tik: Tzijtum tas satub'takxonhej yoch ix sk'ulej Jehová t'ay, xchiokab'i.

Ha jun chonhab' tik syik'cha'anh sb'a ichok nok' choj te ay smay. Ayik toxo ix och sat nok' t'a junok schib'ej, max och wa'an nok' spechani masanto syamchaji syuk'an schik'il nok', icha chi' yaj heb', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Tato max yal ha katab'an jun chonhab' tik, mokab' alpaxkan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayach jun, to ha tas ol schek Jehová wala', haton yowalil swala'? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Kotanh, ol hach wik'b'at t'a junokxo lugar, talaj hata' ol scha' sk'o'ol Dios ha katab'an heb' israel chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winhaj Balac chi' t'a jolom witz Peor, b'aj te chekel kilan masanil tzinan lu'um.

Ayik ayek' heb' winh ta', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Balac chi' icha tik: --Chek b'ochajk'e uke'okxo altar t'a tik hin k'ana', tza chekan miljokcham ukwanhok nok' kelemtak wakax yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, xchi winh.
Ix schekan winhaj Balac b'ojok ukexo altar chi' yik snhusjitz'a juntzanh nok' chi' t'a yib'anh.
